name: Canon Quality Score (Canon Score)
status: Structured, partly subjective quality checklist combining business quality, governance, tradability and price. Weights and thresholds are author judgement; not validated against investment results. Written after seeing 2021 bank data (in-sample).
applies_to: Scores made on or after 2026-11-22. Never applied retroactively to version 1.2 scores or to the 1.2-P forward record.

conventions.boundary: A value exactly on a band boundary takes the higher band.
conventions.two_rows: If a company fits two rows for any other reason, take the lower score.
conventions.aggregation: Sum of seven dimension scores (0-100); never averaged.
conventions.price_dependence: Dimensions 3 and 4 depend on the share price and trading; record the price date with every score.
conventions.record: Record rubric version, data cut-off date and share-price date with every score.
conventions.year_counting: 'In at least 4 of the last 5 years' compares each of the last five years with the year before (needs six years of data).
conventions.missing_data: An unverified sub-component scores no higher than its middle row and is marked 'not verified' (tables may set a stricter limit). If more than 20 of 100 points are unverified or estimated, the total is 'provisional'.
conventions.big_swing: A year-on-year change of more than 50%, up or down. Moderate = no big swing; very volatile / erratic = two or more big swings in five years.

sub.name: 3-year average ROE
sub.definition: Each year: net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders / average equity ((opening+closing)/2). Simple average of the three annual ROEs. Standalone accounts; group accounts only if most business is in subsidiaries (note it).
bands: 15%+ with no year below 10%
10%-15%, or 15%+ with one year below 10%
below 7%, or negative in any of the last 3 years

sub.name: Capital adequacy (BFIs)
sub.definition: Total CAR versus the NRB minimum for the institution's class. Commercial banks: 11% including 2.5-point conservation buffer (verified). Microfinance: 8% total, 4% core (2026 news reports; not checked against the directive). Development banks and finance companies: 10% (NRB Bank Supervision Report 2020/21) or 11% (2026 secondary summary); until checked against the current Unified Directive, use the higher figure.
bands: 2 points or more above class minimum
0.5 to 2 points above
0 to 0.5 points above
below minimum at any point in last 3 years

sub.name: Leverage (non-financial companies)
bands: D/E < 1.0x and interest cover > 5x
D/E 1.0x-2.0x with cover 3x-5x
D/E 2.0x-3.0x, or cover 1.5x-3x
D/E > 3.0x, or cover < 1.5x

sub.name: Earnings quality, 5-year profit history
bands: no loss year; profit grew in at least 4 of 5 years
one loss year, or two flat or declining years
no loss year but flat or declining in 3+ years
two or more loss years, or erratic
adjustments: Non-financial companies: if 3-year operating cash flow < 50% of 3-year net profit, drop one row.
Lenders: asset quality handled in Dimension 6.

sub.name: Promoter holding stability and pledging (3 years)
bands: stable or rising; under 10% pledged
broadly stable; 10%-25% pledged
falling without stated reason, or 25%-50% pledged
falling sharply without stated reason, more than 50% pledged, or repeated insider selling
source_order: company share register / annual report shareholding note
sub.explained_falls: Falls from mergers, legally required sales or new public issues are not penalised; only unexplained or repeated falls count.
sub.missing_data: Pledging not verified: at most 4 of 6.

sub.name: Audit opinion and related-party dealings
bands: clean opinion; small, fully disclosed RPT
clean opinion with emphasis of matter (not going concern)
prior-year restatement, or large but disclosed RPT
qualified opinion on a limited, explained matter
qualified on loans, provisions or RPT; scope limitation on a material area; or going-concern uncertainty
adverse opinion, disclaimer, or undisclosed RPT found

sub.name: Disclosure and board independence
sub.legal_minimum: Banks and financial institutions: BAFIA 2073 s14 - board of 5 to 7 directors, at least 1 independent (professional) director (s14(1), s14(3), NepalLaws text; s2 definition in UNODC copy). Other public companies: Companies Act 2063 s86(3) - at least 1 independent director on a board of up to 7, at least 2 on a larger board (NepalLaws summary; Act text not reached).
bands: all quarterly reports and AGM on time for 3 years, and more independent directors than legal minimum
on time with exactly the minimum, or independence not verified
repeated late filings, or below the legal minimum
penalised by SEBON or NEPSE for disclosure failure in last 3 years

dimensions.name: Liquidity & Tradability

sub.name: Average daily turnover, 6 months
sub.definition: Total value traded over 6 months / number of NEPSE trading days, including zero-trade days.
bands: Rs 5 million+
Rs 1-5 million
Rs 0.2-1 million
below Rs 0.2 million
adjustments: Thin trading: traded on fewer than half of trading days -> at most 1.

sub.name: Free float
bands: below 10%

dimensions.note: Floors, not fine ranking. Position-size liquidity is checked separately by Chapter 56's ADV rule.

dimensions.name: Valuation Reasonableness

sub.name: P/E vs sector median
bands: 0.8x or below (needs ROE >= sector median ROE, else 6)
above 1.5x, or operating loss over last 12 months
sub.not_scorable: Hydropower before commercial operation: score from P/B row (7->8, 5->6, 3->3, 1->1).

sub.name: P/B vs sector median
bands: 0.8x or below (needs ROE >= sector median ROE, else 5)
above 1.5x, or negative book value

dimensions.sector_median: NEPSE sector groups; at least 5 companies (else 'not verified', middle row); P/E uses trailing 12-month EPS and excludes loss-makers; simple median; record price date.
dimensions.note: P/E and P/B move with the same price: read as one view. Company's own 5-year median is a cross-check only.

sub.name: Moat
bands: high barriers and proof: 3-year ROE >= sector median (hydropower: operating plant delivering >= 90% of contracted energy in 2 of last 3 years)
moderate barriers, or licence/regulated position without proof
low barriers; commodity-like
structural regulatory or technological threat

sub.name: Revenue concentration
bands: no customer or segment above 20%
20%-40% from one segment or counterparty
above 40% from one counterparty
sub.note: Sector versions in Chapter 65 (e.g. hydropower single-buyer PPA).

sub.name: 5-year revenue CAGR (non-lenders)
sub.definition: Operating revenue only; exclude one-off, revaluation and non-operating income. Merger/acquisition in period: use combined figures, else at most 6 and note 'merger'.
bands: 15%+, positive in at least 4 of 5 years
negative, or very volatile

sub.name: Loan growth vs system (lenders)
sub.rationale: Lender income is mainly interest, which moves with rates as well as lending; the loan book is the better measure of expansion.
bands: within 5 points of system, either way
5-10 points faster or slower
more than 10 points faster or slower, or shrinking while system grows
adjustment_order: 1. Credit peak (system credit growth > 20% or system CD ratio within 5 points of ceiling) and lender > 5 points faster than system: 0, stop.
2. Loans > 5 points faster than deposits: drop one row.
3. NPL ratio above system average and higher than a year earlier: drop one row. Steps 2-3 cannot take score below 2.
4. No verified system figure for same period: at most 5.

sub.name: EPS on a comparable share count, 5 years
sub.definition: Use reported basic EPS as restated in the latest annual report (NFRS / IAS 33 restate for bonus issues and the bonus element of rights issues); do not adjust twice. If only unrestated reports: divide earlier EPS by (1 + bonus ratio) per later bonus; for a rights issue below market, divide by (pre-issue price / theoretical ex-rights price). If unclear, rebuild from net profit and weighted average shares.
bands: rose in at least 4 of 5 years, no big swing
rose in 3 of 5 years, at most one big swing
rose in 2 of 5 years, or very volatile
rose in fewer than 2 years, or negative in 3+ years

dimensions.name: Dividend & Capital Return Discipline

sub.name: Consistency, 5 years
sub.definition: A year counts as paid only with a real cash dividend (not cash that only covers the 5% tax on a bonus issue). Payout = (cash + bonus) / distributable profit. 30%-70% is a design preference.
bands: real cash dividend every year; payout 30%-70%
real cash in 4 of 5 years, or payout consistently below 30% or above 70%
real cash in 2-3 of 5 years, erratic
real cash in 0-1 of 5 years

sub.name: Source and purpose
bands: genuine distributable profit; reserves intact or growing; any bonus tied to stated capital need
partly one-off or revaluation gains, or bonus with no stated use
drawn from capital or reserves

dimensions.retained_by_design: Hydropower before COD, or bank/insurer barred from paying by regulator capital rules: consistency 4/6, source 2/4, marked 'retained by design'.

score_bands: Exceptional; core holding up to 6%-8% of equity sleeve

triggers: audit/related-party check scores 1 or less of 5

exclude: court or regulator finding of fraud by management or controlling shareholders
provisional: accounts materially restated (until a full year of new audited figures)

known_overlaps: About 25-30 of 100 points rest directly or indirectly on reported profit (ROE, earnings quality, EPS growth, dividend consistency, ROE gate on valuation).
comparability: Compare totals within a sector; cross-sector comparability is a design aim, not tested.
still_judgement: what counts as a 'segment' in revenue concentration
when a gain is 'one-off' in the dividend source check

items: one home dimension per indicator to limit double counting
growth judged by return on new capital
compare weights with simple alternatives such as equal weights
double-counting diagnostic: correlation of sub-scores, leave-one-dimension-out ranking changes, equal-weight comparison (Chapter 80 audit)

test_protocol: scores frozen before results are known
whole sector including merged, failed and delisted companies
comparison with simple alternatives such as equal weights
history: closed table gaps and overlaps, bonus-adjusted EPS, severe-red-flag override trigger with cap 54, aligned bands with Ch66, capped unverified pledging
lender loan growth vs system with credit-peak cap and funding check; valuation discount needs ROE >= sector median

complete scoring rules for steps left to judgement in 1.2; CAR vs class minimum; ROE, ADV, swing definitions; cash and thin-trading checks; lender asset-quality step and adjustment order; EPS per NFRS/IAS 33 incl. rights bonus element; real-cash dividend rule; sector-median and loss-maker rules; licence alone not full moat; pledge source order; extra hard limits. Weights and bands unchanged.
